face_review: Compared visible human facial structure, ignoring hair and ornament color: jaw/cheek width, eye shape and slope, nose and lip proportions. Same identity retained across this character set.
casual_diversity: Compared saved plans and submitted prompts from recent characters. Planned distinct places, activities, clothing silhouettes, times, lights, expression/pose/orientation/framing/lens choices; changed at least three of place/activity/clothing/composition from similar candidates. All three scenes retain strong overall intensity and bold skin exposure.
image_review: Single adult woman; same face/hair/body; no weapons or lettering; complete connected hands and five natural digits each; 2:3. Closed/opened pairs retain camera, pose and subject scale. Three casual locations/actions/clothing silhouettes differ.
